original_question: Dalibai dake dakin taro na wata makaranta sun kai 1000. Dakin taron yana da ƙofofin shiga 3, A, B, da C wanda kuma suka kasance a matsayin mafita. Idan bayan taro kashi 30% na daliban sun fita daga ginin ta hanyar mafitar A, 3/5 na ragowar sun fita ta mafitar B, sauran kuma sun fita ta hanyar C, a lissafa adadin daliban da suka fita ta hanyar C. .
question_template: Dalibai dake dakin taro na wata makaranta sun kai {num_digit_1, 1000}. Dakin taron yana da ƙofofin shiga {num_digit_2, 3}, A, B, da C wanda kuma suka kasance a matsayin mafita. Idan bayan taro kashi {num_digit_3, 30}% na daliban sun fita daga ginin ta hanyar mafitar A, {num_frac_1, 3/5} na ragowar sun fita ta mafitar B, sauran kuma sun fita ta hanyar C, a lissafa adadin daliban da suka fita ta hanyar C. .
